name: E02_7_crossway_troublemakers_one_life_cannot_pay_two
notes: G2 verifier, batch E. Printed: 'Whenever a Vampire you control dies, you may pay 2 life. If you do, draw a card.' A player can pay life only if their life total is at least the payment (CR 119.4), so with 1 life seat 0 cannot pay 2: although it takes the may (fire), no life is paid (1, not -1), no card is drawn (hand stays 0) and seat 0 is still in the game.
